name: Insecure Apps/Plugins
definition: Degree to which the system is protected from vulnerabilities introduced by insecure apps/plugins and third-party integrations.

values.name: Formally Verified
values.definition: Secure development and integration practices for apps/plugins enforced, with formal verification of their security.

values.name: Strong Guidelines
values.definition: Strong security guidelines and vetting process for apps/plugins, minimizing the risk of vulnerabilities introduced by third-party integrations.

values.name: Some Measures
values.definition: Some security measures for apps/plugins, but risks remain, and vulnerabilities may be introduced through insecure integrations.

values.name: High Risk
values.definition: High risk of vulnerabilities from insecure apps/plugins, with no or minimal measures to ensure the security of third-party integrations.
